question: Should QQBot keep `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` as a supported data-directory override, or should the diagnostic stop recommending it now that runtime state has moved toward plugin SQLite KV and `OPENCLAW_HOME`-based media roots?
rationale: Current main advertises the env var in diagnostics, but implementing it creates real config/env and path-selection behavior in a legacy-adjacent storage helper, which repository policy treats as a compatibility-sensitive product decision.

options.title: Support a validated override
options.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safe `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require redacted real diagnostic proof before merge.

options.title: Retire the env hint
options.body: Remove or replace the `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` diagnostic guidance and close the linked implementation PR as not planned for this storage path.

recommendation.title: Support a validated override
recommendation.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safe `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require redacted real diagnostic proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot SQLite migration work makes steipete the best available owner for the data-root contract decision.
